subject: Vendor onboarding: invoice labeling, portal migration timeline & sample rows
messages:
From: accounts-payable@bluepeak.com
To: marissa.cole@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 1 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Vendor onboarding: invoice submission & labeling

Hi Marissa —

We're kicking off vendor setup for BluePeak and want to confirm Redwood's preferred invoice intake. A few quick questions:

1) Do you prefer invoices uploaded to a portal or submitted by email?
2) If email, what subject token or filename conventions should we use so the system automatically associates to the PO?
3) Do you accept a single PDF with multiple invoices, or do you want one invoice per file/row?

I've attached one of our typical invoices (sample_invoice_202605.pdf) and a CSV extract of line items (invoice_template_rows.csv). Can you confirm what minimal metadata you need on the file/subject line so we have fewer exceptions on first pass?

Thanks,
Nina Patel
Accounts Payable | BluePeak Logistics
attachments: sample_invoice_202605.pdf (pdf), invoice_template_rows.csv (csv)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Nina Patel <accounts-payable@bluepeak.com>
Cc: karthik.iyer@redwood.com, vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 1 Jun 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding: invoice submission & labeling

Hi Nina —

Thanks — this is great context and the attachments helped. Short answers up front:

• Preferred channel: portal first, email fallback. Portal gives faster ACKs and idempotent ingestion.
• If email: subject token helps a lot. Current recommended subject format: BP-INV|<PO#>|<YYYYMMDD>|<INV#>. Example: BP-INV|PO-7921|20260601|INV-4521. Include PO in the subject and place the PO on the first line of the PDF body as well.
• File format: we prefer one invoice per file for PDF submissions. For historical reasons we accept multi-invoice PDFs but they increase manual processing rates. If you must send consolidated files, please include a table-of-contents page with invoice filenames and PO mappings.

Minimum metadata we require to auto-route: PO number, vendor legal name, invoice date, invoice total, invoice number. If those fields are present in the filename or subject we can auto-associate ~85% of cases.

I've attached our onboarding checklist and a compact CSV sample that matches our ingestion schema (invoice_template_rows.csv). Can you try re-sending one sample email with the subject token above and attach a single invoice PDF so we can validate ingestion in the sandbox?

Next steps:
1) Nina: send one sample to ap-inbox+sandbox@redwood.com with subject using the BP-INV token.
2) Marissa/Vanessa: run the sample through the sandbox ingestion and report mapping exceptions.
3) Karthik: if we see edge-case fields (multi-PO per invoice), propose fallback mapping rules.

Thanks — attaching portal_onboarding_checklist.pdf for your team.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Vendor Onboarding Lead | Redwood Inference
attachments: portal_onboarding_checklist.pdf (pdf), invoice_template_rows.csv (csv)

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
To: marissa.cole@redwood.com
Cc: vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 2 Jun 2026 09:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding: invoice submission & labeling

Marissa —

Quick note on the multi-PO edge case: our ingestion supports a CSV payload per invoice that includes a 'related_po' column; when vendors send a single PDF that references multiple POs we can accept a companion CSV with one row per invoice mapping to each PO. That keeps the PDF as canonical while giving us structured PO linkage.

If BluePeak plans to transition from email to portal over the next 4–6 weeks we should:
• Provide them a temporary subject-token pattern for the migration window (we already recommended BP-INV|...).
• Offer a weekly sync for the first two weeks of onboarding to review exceptions.

I'll prepare a quick fallback mapping doc for cases where PO is missing but can be inferred from invoice line descriptions.

—Karthik
Director, Procurement Integrations | Redwood Inference

From: Nina Patel <accounts-payable@bluepeak.com>
To: ap-inbox+sandbox@redwood.com
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 5 Jun 2026 14:48:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding: invoice submission & labeling

Hi Marissa / Karthik —

Thanks for the clear guidance. We tried the subject token and sent one single-invoice PDF to the sandbox (invoice_BP-4521.pdf). Please see attached; we also included a small CSV with line mapping where one PDF contained two charge lines.

Questions:
• If we need to send a wire- or remittance-only document (no PO), should we still use BP-INV and leave PO blank, or use a separate subject token BP-REM?
• During the migration window, is there a cutover date after which email submissions will be rejected?

We’re happy to join a 30-minute call next week to walk through the first three sandbox examples.

Best,
Nina Patel
Accounts Payable | BluePeak Logistics
attachments: invoice_BP-4521.pdf (pdf), sample_lines_mapping.csv (csv)
